data.one_liner: CLI tool that automates Flutter app configuration, asset generation and release workflows.
data.what_it_does: Publish provides an interactive wizard to set up app name, package ID, icons and splash screens. It manages multiple environment profiles, preserves version and assets per profile, and automates version bumps, changelog updates and signing.
use_when: You need to configure and maintain multiple Flutter build flavors
You want to generate icons and splash screens from a single source image
You want to automate versioning, changelog and signing for releases
avoid_when: Your project is very simple with a single configuration
You already have a custom CI/CD pipeline handling these tasks
strengths: Multi‑config profile management with asset and version preservation
Interactive setup and doctor commands to fix common issues
Automates signing, version bumps and changelog updates
weaknesses: Limited to Flutter projects; not a general purpose build tool
May not cover all edge‑case CI/CD requirements
data.setup_notes: Activate globally with `flutter pub global activate publish`; then run `publish` commands from any terminal.

alternatives.name: flutter_launcher_icons
alternatives.why_pick_it: Generates app icons for Android and iOS without the broader configuration and release automation features

data.minimal_example:
```bash
# Install globally
flutter pub global activate publish

# Run the interactive setup wizard
publish init

# Generate icons from a single image
publish icons
```
